draft.title: Life in Sparta
card: Sparta was a Greek city-state built around war. Its citizens were full-time soldiers, so life was organised to produce strong, obedient fighters.
Spartan boys left home at age 7 to join a state training system. They learned to fight, to endure hardship and to obey orders.
an enslaved people who farmed the land for the Spartans. They grew the food, so Spartan citizens were free to train and fight.
Because the helots outnumbered their Spartan masters, Sparta kept a strong army. The army also guarded against helot revolts.
draft.remember: Sparta put war first: boys trained as soldiers, and helots grew the food.

a.q: Why did Spartan citizens have time to train as full-time soldiers?
opts: Helots farmed the land and grew their food
Foreign traders supplied all the city's food
Spartan women did all the farming and trading
Boys were sent home to farm after age 7
a.why: Helots, an enslaved people, did the farming for Sparta. This freed Spartan citizens to train and fight. Boys did not return home to farm, because they left home at age 7 for military training.
a.clue: Who grew the food in Sparta?

b.q: Leon is a Spartan boy who turns 7. What is most likely to happen to him?
opts: He leaves home to begin training as a soldier
He starts work as a farmer on his family's land
He begins to learn a trade from his father
He joins the Assembly to vote on new laws
b.why: Spartan boys left home at age 7 to join the state training system. Farming was done by helots, not by Spartan boys. Voting in the Assembly belongs to Athens, not Sparta.
b.clue: Think about what Sparta was built for.

a.best: Helots farmed the land and grew their food

b.best: He leaves home to begin training as a soldier

problems.detail: Why (b) says 'Voting in the Assembly belongs to Athens, not Sparta.' Sparta also had a citizen assembly (the Apella), where adult male citizens voted, usually by shouting. The option is still wrong because a 7-year-old would not vote, so the why should give that reason instead.

check.summary: The card and both questions are accurate, and each question has one clear right answer. Why (b) wrongly says Sparta had no Assembly; it should say instead that a 7-year-old boy could not vote.
